mission_09: A symmetric positive definite matrix can be built as A = M @ M.T + I.
Use scipy.linalg.cholesky(A, lower=True) for Cholesky decomposition.
Solve Ly = b with scipy.linalg.solve_triangular(L, b, lower=True).
Solve L^T x = y with scipy.linalg.solve_triangular(L.T, y, lower=False).
Use scipy.linalg.lu(A) for LU decomposition (returns P, L, U).
Verify Cholesky with np.allclose(L @ L.T, A).
